newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Sonae floats real estate arm.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Sonae floats real estate arm.

text.p: Sonae Investimentos said on Friday that a 24 percent stake in its real estate concern Sonae Imobiliaria would be floated on the bourse in the last quarter of 1997.
The group sold 49 percent of Imobiliaria to a banking consortium at the end of last year.

The shares to be floated would come from this stake while the remainder of the consortium's investment was being sold to Grosvenor Estate Holdings, a property firm headed by the Duke of Westminster, one of Britain's wealthiest men.
Sonae said that it was delighted that Grosvenor would be taking a stake in the property group as a strategic partner.
Imobiliaria's issued capital stands at eight billion escudos. Sonae Investimentos will remain with a 51 percent stake.
